scope: Retained-log reanalysis only; no new rollouts, training or timing measurements.

structural_conditions.general: Same initial full state, policy weights, cache transformation and random draws; equal delivered payload/sender/timestamp inputs each step imply equal subsequent states/actions/rewards inductively. Ordered input equality is sufficient; for order-invariant aggregation it can be weakened to sender-keyed equality.
structural_conditions.specialization: Full queue begins at t mod N; RR starts at cursor 0 and advances by admitted count. With exactly one successful packet/step, no skipped admission, matching payload/cache/readiness, both deliver t mod N. For constant 1<=k<N, Full begins at t while RR begins at kt; equal sets require (k-1)t=0 mod N. k=1 guarantees equality; equal count alone does not.
structural_conditions.offered_bytes: 5 Full attempts versus 1 RR attempt yields 80% offered-byte reduction. Actual serialized bytes, RF energy and physical channel occupancy were not recorded.
structural_conditions.prefix: Shared RR prefix equalizes full joint history at branching. Cold versus prefix comparisons cannot isolate a unique cache mediator.
structural_conditions.timing: 3 packets at 100000 B/s and 48 B each require readiness <= deadline -450us reserve -50us propagation -1440us serialization; opportunity also requires credit and actual admission.
